in_hebrew.name: Laura
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Crowned with laurel
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Laura הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Laura is derived from the Latin name 'Lauro', meaning 'laurel'. In ancient Rome, laurel wreaths were used to symbolize victory and triumph. In Christian tradition, Laura is a feminine name that signifies the triumph of faith and the crowned glory of a virtuous life.

in_latin.name: Laura
in_latin.meaning: Laurel tree, symbolizing victory, peace, and honor
in_latin.long_meaning: Laurea, derived from Greek (lauros), signifying a wreath of leaves, originally from ancient Greece, used to crown victorious athletes and poets, in Christian tradition, represents spiritual victory and triumph over sin
